title: The Metric Slingshot: Navigational Reuse as Width-Optimal Structural Decoupling in Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.15412v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The mammalian brain, most extensively studied in rodents and bats, solves an enormous variety of non-spatial cognitive tasks using neural circuitry, including grid cells, place cells, and hippocampal indexing, that originally evolved for physical navigation. We formalize the above observation within the local Urysohn width (LUW) framework for continual learning. The central construct is the \emph{metric slingshot}: a learned embedding $\phi: X \to Z$ that maps an arbitrary learning problem into a navigational latent space $Z$ where pre-evolved contraction maps (grid cells) already provide the metric machinery, so that only the topological indexing subproblem must be solved de novo. We prove three results. translated_title: 度量弹弓：持续学习中作为宽度最优结构解耦的导航复用
translated_abstract: 哺乳动物大脑（在啮齿类动物和蝙蝠中研究最为广泛）利用最初为物理导航而演化的神经回路（包括网格细胞、位置细胞和海马索引机制）来解决大量非空间认知任务。我们在持续学习的局部Urysohn宽度（LUW）框架内对上述观察进行了形式化。核心构造是“度量弹弓”：一个学习到的嵌入φ: X → Z，它将任意学习问题映射到一个导航潜空间Z，其中预先演化的收缩映射（网格细胞）已经提供了度量机制，因此只需从头解决拓扑索引子问题。我们证明了三个结果。第一，多尺度网格细胞模块的最优间距是一个几何级数，其比率由LUW框架的Ω(w log w)样本复杂度界决定；对于生态上合理的参数，最优性…
tldr: 论文提出“度量弹弓”理论框架，证明大脑通过将任意学习问题嵌入到预先演化的导航潜空间（由网格细胞提供度量机制），使持续学习只需从头解决拓扑索引子问题，并数学推导出多尺度网格细胞模块的最优间距构成几何级数，其比率由LUW框架的样本复杂度界决定。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the "metric slingshot" framework, formally proving that the brain solves arbitrary learning problems by embedding them into a pre-evolved navigational latent space where grid cells already provide the metric machinery, so that only the topological indexing subproblem must be solved de novo, and derives that the optimal spacing of multi-scale grid cell modules forms a geometric series determined by the Ω(w log w) sample complexity bound.
